summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Prova microfono e livello audio' (MicCheck) in the consultation setup. All 7 requested scenarios pass. getUserMedia and enumerateDevices were mocked through add_init_script: an oscillator stream whose gain can be changed, a wrapper that counts track.stop() calls, and either 2 fake audio inputs or 1.

results.button_visibility: PASS - mic-check-btn is visible in setup. It disappears in manual mode (count 0) and comes back when you switch back to voice.
results.meter_and_verdict: PASS - the meter shows mic-check-waiting first, then mic-check-meter. data-level updates live (14 -> 21). Gain 0.1 gives verdict good. Gain 0.8 gives level 100 and verdict high (red/amber bars, 'Troppo alto'). Gain 0 after speech gives verdict low. Before any sound the verdict is 'silent', and it goes back to good when the level recovers.
results.device_selection: PASS - with 2 inputs, mic-check-device lists 'Microfono A (USB)' and 'Microfono B (Cuffie)'. Choosing B saves localStorage mantmed-mic=mic-B, stops the old track and calls getUserMedia again with {deviceId:{ideal:'mic-B'}}. With a single input the select is hidden.
results.permission_denied: PASS - mic-check-error shows 'Accesso al microfono negato: lo consenta dall'icona del lucchetto...'. Closing and reopening after permission is granted brings the meter back.
results.close_stops_tracks: PASS - with 'Fine prova', live tracks go 1 -> 0 and the button comes back. Closing while getUserMedia is still pending leaves no orphan track. Turning on manual mode or closing the overlay with the panel open also leaves 0 live tracks.
results.begin_with_panel_open: PASS - with a free name and the paper consent ticked, consult-begin-btn starts recording (timer runs). The recorder's getUserMedia gets {audio:{deviceId:{ideal:'mic-B'}}}, and the panel's track is stopped when it unmounts.
results.regression_validations: PASS - with the panel open, the inline errors still appear: no name, no paper consent (the checkbox starts unchecked, so the iteration_33 reset fix is confirmed), and NotAllowedError when starting. The panel stays open after a validation error.

issues: The device picker is a native <select>. It works, but it is unlike the shadcn Select used elsewhere, and the native dropdown list may render with light OS styling on the dark overlay.

critical_code_review_comments: MicCheck verdict UX: the verdict uses the instant smoothed level (decay 0.9 per frame, about 200ms from 20 down to 6). Once heard >= 6, every natural pause between words makes the verdict jump to 'Troppo basso' (amber). Real speech will make it flicker between good and low. Base the verdict on a rolling peak or average over about 1-2s, or keep 'low' only after a sustained period.
The error state has no 'Riprova' button. The user has to press 'Fine prova' and reopen. Consider adding a retry.

If the saved mantmed-mic deviceId no longer exists (mic unplugged), the select value matches no option, so the browser shows the first option while getUserMedia(ideal) may pick another device. Fall back to devices[0] or to the actual track.getSettings().deviceId when the saved id is not in the list.
setLevel runs on every animation frame (about 60 re-renders per second of the panel). This is fine for 24 bars, but it could be throttled to about 20fps.

Clicking 'Inizia registrazione' with the panel open briefly opens two capture streams on the same device: the recorder requests its stream before the panel unmounts. This worked in testing. On some platforms exclusive-mode devices can throw NotReadableError, so closing the panel before rec.start() would be safer.
action_items: Optional: stabilise the verdict over a time window so it does not flicker to 'Troppo basso' between words
Optional: handle a stale saved deviceId in the select; add a retry button in the error state
seed_data_creation: Started a recording for 'TEST Mic Rossi' (free visit), then closed the overlay without sending.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mock getUserMedia via page.add_init_script: AudioContext oscillator -> GainNode -> MediaStreamDestination. Expose window.__setGain(v) to drive the meter (0.1 -> good, about level 21; 0.8 -> high; 0 -> low). Wrap track.stop to count live tracks. Mock enumerateDevices to return 2 audioinputs so the select shows.
